name: TX-08
label: Safe R

key_factors: Republican nominee heavily outraises and outspends Democrat
Open seat with no incumbent effect
model.rationale: The district's R+13 lean, the Republican nominee's roughly 90-to-1 fundraising advantage plus outside support, and markets pricing the race near 95% Republican all point to a comfortable hold. With no polls or expert ratings available, the fundamentals carry the forecast.
model.watch: Any late polling or a surge of Democratic outside spending could signal a closer race than fundamentals suggest.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: Morgan Luttrell (R) is not on the ballot.

overview: TX-08 is an open Republican-held seat north of Houston after Morgan Luttrell's retirement. The district carries a 13-point Republican lean, and the Republican nominee, Jessica Hart Steinmann, has raised over $2 million with additional outside support, while Democrat Laura Jones has raised under $25,000 with no outside spending on either side. Prediction markets put the Republican near 95%. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals and the lopsided resource gap. The seat remains safely Republican, with the main question being the size of the winning margin rather than which party wins.
